nodes.description: Address of the contract owner; gates privileged functions and is exempted in ensure().
Public mapping of token balances, mutated unchecked in transferFrom and batchSend.
Public nested mapping of spender allowances, mutated in approve and transferFrom.
Private mapping counting sales per sender, compared against _saleNum in condition().
Private whitelist mapping used by ensure() to bypass the sale condition.
Private sale limit counter configured by init().
Address whitelisted in ensure(), writable only by owner through setTradeAddress().
Hard-coded constant Uniswap router address whitelisted in ensure().
Payable constructor minting the whole supply to msg.sender and setting unlimited allowance to the router.
Public payable transfer that delegates to transferFrom using msg.sender as the source.
Public payable transferFrom with unchecked balance/allowance mutations and whitelist checks.
Internal whitelist check; returns true for owner/UNI/tradeAddress/canSale addresses, otherwise calls condition().
Internal sale policy check against _saleNum, _onSaleNum, _minSale and _maxSale.
Public payable approval writing directly to the allowance mapping.
Owner-only arbitrary delegatecall executor, a critical access-control and hijack vector.
Owner-only configuration of sale limits; computes _minSale and _maxSale with scaling arithmetic.
Owner-only mass distribution loop with unchecked multiplication, subtraction and additions.
Owner-only setter for the tradeAddress whitelist.
Internal pure Uniswap pair address derivation used by ensure().
msg.sender, used for authorization checks, as allowance owner and as transfer source.
a.delegatecall(b) on an attacker-controlled address executing arbitrary code in this contract's storage context.
balanceOf[msg.sender] -= total, unchecked arithmetic on state balance.
balanceOf[_from] -= _value, unchecked arithmetic on state balance.
balanceOf[_to] += _value, unchecked arithmetic on state balance.
allowance[_from][msg.sender] -= _value, unchecked arithmetic on state allowance.
_onSaleNum[_from]++ unchecked counter increment bracketing the state writes.
uint total = _value * _tos.length, unchecked multiplication that can overflow.
token*(10**uint256(decimals)) and maxToken*(10**uint256(decimals)) scaling multiplications in init().
Parameter _to of transfer(): destination address.
Parameter _value of transfer(): amount to move.
Parameter _from of transferFrom(): source account whose balance is debited.
Parameter _to of transferFrom(): destination account credited.
Parameter _value of transferFrom(): amount checked against balance and allowance.
Parameter _spender of approve(): allowance beneficiary.
Parameter _value of approve(): allowance amount written directly into storage.
Parameter a of delegate(): target address receiving delegatecall.
Parameter b of delegate(): raw calldata forwarded to the delegatecall target.
Parameter saleNum of init(): per-sender sale limit.
Parameter token of init(): minimum sale scaled into _minSale.
Parameter maxToken of init(): maximum sale scaled into _maxSale.
Parameter _tos of batchSend(): array of recipient addresses.
Parameter _value of batchSend(): per-recipient amount.
Parameter addr of setTradeAddress(): new whitelist address.
Constructor parameter _name stored into the token name.
Constructor parameter _symbol stored into the token symbol.
Constructor parameter _supply scaled into totalSupply and minted to msg.sender.
Parameter _from of ensure(): address tested against the whitelist.
Parameter _value of ensure(): amount forwarded to condition().
Parameter _from of condition(): address whose _onSaleNum is checked.
Parameter _value of condition(): amount compared to _minSale and _maxSale.
Local total of batchSend(): unchecked product of _value and _tos.length.
Local loop index i of batchSend().
Local _UNI of ensure(): pair address derived from pairFor().

edges.reason: delegate() is gated by require(msg.sender == owner), so only the owner key can reach the arbitrary delegatecall.
Owner-controlled msg.sender authorizes the arbitrary delegatecall sink.
delegate() forwards caller-supplied address into a delegatecall, letting owner-supplied code run with this contract's storage.
The delegatecall target executes arbitrary external code inside delegate()'s context, enabling re-entrant state manipulation.
Constructor assigns ownership to the deployer.
msg.sender is written into the owner state variable during construction.
Constructor mints the total supply into balanceOf[msg.sender].
Constructor sets an unlimited allowance for the hard-coded router.
batchSend() is restricted to the owner via require(msg.sender == owner).
init() is restricted to the owner and rewrites the sale policy.
setTradeAddress() is restricted to the owner and controls the whitelist.
setTradeAddress() writes the new whitelisted trade address.
init() sets _saleNum used by condition().
init() performs unchecked token*(10**decimals) scaling arithmetic for _minSale and _maxSale.
transfer() delegates its logic to transferFrom().
transferFrom() compares msg.sender to _from for allowance consumption.
transferFrom() calls ensure() to validate the transfer policy.
ensure() calls condition() when the sender is not whitelisted.
ensure() derives the pair address through pairFor().
ensure() reads tradeAddress for its whitelist comparison.
ensure() reads canSale[_from] to bypass the sale condition.
ensure() compares _from and _to against owner for the whitelist.
condition() reads _saleNum to bound per-sender sales.
condition() reads _onSaleNum[_from] against the sale limit.
transferFrom() reads and decrements allowance[_from][msg.sender].
transferFrom() performs an unchecked allowance subtraction.
transferFrom() reads and mutates the balanceOf mapping.
transferFrom() performs an unchecked balance subtraction on the sender.
transferFrom() performs an unchecked balance addition on the recipient.
transferFrom() increments the _onSaleNum counter without bounds checks.
approve() writes directly into the allowance mapping.
approve() uses msg.sender as the allowance owner.
batchSend() reads and mutates balanceOf entries for the sender and recipients.
batchSend() computes _value * _tos.length without overflow protection.
batchSend() debits balanceOf[msg.sender] with unchecked arithmetic.
batchSend() authorizes msg.sender and then debits that same account.
transfer() passes msg.sender as the _from source to transferFrom().
_to parameter flows into the transfer() forwarding call.
_value parameter flows into the transfer() forwarding call.
_from parameter drives the balance and allowance lookups of transferFrom().
_to parameter receives the credited balance in transferFrom().
_value parameter controls the allowance requirement and balance movement.
_value is subtracted from allowance without a checked math library.
_value is subtracted from balanceOf[_from] unchecked.
_spender parameter sets the allowance key in approve().
_value parameter is written verbatim into allowance[msg.sender][_spender].
Address parameter a becomes the delegatecall target, enabling arbitrary code execution.
Bytes parameter b is the calldata executed by the delegatecall.
saleNum parameter is stored into _saleNum.
token parameter is scaled with an unchecked multiplication.
maxToken parameter is scaled with an unchecked multiplication.
_tos array length multiplies _value in an unchecked product.
_value parameter is the multiplicand of the unchecked total computation.
addr parameter is stored into tradeAddress.
_name constructor parameter is persisted to storage.
_symbol constructor parameter is persisted to storage.
_supply constructor parameter defines totalSupply and the initial mint.
_from parameter is compared against the whitelist inside ensure().
_value parameter is forwarded from ensure() into condition().
_from parameter keys the _onSaleNum lookup in condition().
_value parameter is compared to _minSale and _maxSale in condition().
Local total is subtracted from balanceOf[msg.sender] without a checked subtraction.
Loop index i controls the iteration of the batchSend() distribution loop.
Local _UNI pair address supplements the whitelist condition in ensure().
